events.title: The release date, new trailer, and ways to support Outcast Tales
events.summary: The release is set for October 26 As promised before, the game is entirely free from day one. You will not find any paid DLC or microtransactions here. Just download Outcast Tales, play it, and enjoy. While you wait, the demo is available and ready for you. Your progress can be carried over to the full game. events.title: Outcast Tales will be free
events.summary: As in, completely free. No-strings-attached free. No microtransactions, no dark patterns, no catch. This is a game we wanted to make so very much: a funny story-driven roguelite with hard tactical battles where characters would occasionally act out. We poured a lot of work into it, and we love the result. We want you to play it And we don't want a price tag to stand between the game and the people who might enjoy it. events.title: Outcast Tales Demo Is Out Now!
events.summary: This demo isn't the prologue. It's much larger. Think of it as the full experience, just cut in half. Playtime's roughly doubled: seven new bosses, four times the encounters. And yes, there's a new ending waiting for you on the other side of the desert. We also added a new mechanic. As you travel, every character can unlock one of two secret abilities tied to their class. events.title: Outcast Tales isn't dead!
events.summary: Greetings, misfits! It has been a while. More than 2 years, in fact. Long enough for some of you to reasonably wonder whether Outcast Tales wandered into the Wasteland and got eaten by something with far too many teeth. It hasn't; it was just stuck in a bit of a release limbo, which is now over. So, good news: we are alive. Better news: and fully ready to go. events.title: Fallen Graces
events.summary: Greetings, Misfits! We know it’s a bit frustrating to see these dark silhouettes under the available characters. https://i.imgur.com/oWXrmRl.png Who are they? What do they do? Why do they do what they do? These are the questions we aim to delve into with this devlog to ease the everlasting itch of seeing unavailable content. Meet the future outcasts! events.title: The Other Tales
events.summary: Greetings, Misfits! The release of Outcast Tales is getting closer. We hope the game provides plenty of fun for everyone, with many hours of content to take a crack at. But don’t just sit on your hands simply replaying The First Journey over and over in anticipation, as we will be releasing an update to The First Journey, so you might want to wait before jumping into adventure with fresh eyes.
